name: Iran
description: Follow Iran, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Air Force officer recalls ‘free-falling’ after jet was shot down over Iran
changes.summary: In an interview with CBS’ “60 Minutes,” one of the two U.S. Air Force officers whose fighter jet was shot down over Iran in April detailed his harrowing ordeal.

changes.title: US airman recounts Iran rescue in 60 Minutes segment branded propaganda
changes.summary: Critics say segment about airman’s rescue was made to boost public perception of Trump’s unpopular war A US airman has spoken of climbing a 7,000ft ridge with a broken back, arm and shoulder after he was shot down in Iran – and of being rescued by a team of American special forces as hostile locals closed in on him. changes.title: Saudi Arabia Faces ‘Worst-Case Scenario’ After Iran’s Attacks and Trump’s Rebuffs
changes.summary: The kingdom is in a state of strategic shock after coming under attack from an emboldened Iran and failing to win more U.S. military support, analysts say.

changes.title: World leaders gathered for the annual BRICS summit. Here are the takeaways
changes.summary: India hosted the an annual summit which gathered leaders from 28 countries, including the presidents of China and Iran. Though, the U.S. was notably absent.

changes.title: How Iran’s Hard-liners Blew Up the Peace Deal with Trump
changes.summary: Opponents derailed the agreement with a clandestine effort to attack ships in the Strait of Hormuz, regime insiders say. Iran’s president was furious when he found out.

changes.title: Meeting Between Iran, Arab States Postponed as Mideast Diplomacy Stalls
changes.summary: Talks between the United States and Iran hit a dead end weeks ago, leaving Arab countries struggling to manage their ties to Tehran amid ongoing attacks.

changes.title: As Oil Prices Rise, BRICS Leaders Have What U.S. Doesn’t: Iran at the Table
changes.summary: The group, which includes Iran, has been split over the war. It called for “maximum restraint” in the Middle East without casting blame on any particular country.

changes.title: On board a warship headed to support the war in Iran
changes.summary: The USS George Washington was deployed to New York after the 9/11 attacks. Now, the aircraft carrier is headed to the Middle East to support President Trump's war against Iran. Tom Hanson is on board with a new report.

changes.title: ‘We Left in the Clothes We Were Wearing’: Yemenis Flee New Fighting
changes.summary: Hunger and disease have tormented Yemen for years. Now, fighting between the Saudi-backed government and Iran-backed Houthis is pushing it to the brink.

changes.title: Saudi Arabia has few options as it faces mounting threats from Iran and its allies
changes.summary: A lightning advance by Houthi rebels threatens a crucial Red Sea shipping route. Drone attacks blamed on Iraqi militias have forced the closure of a major pipeline, and Iran is still disrupting the Strait of Hormuz.
